description_full: CK Asset Holdings Limited operates as a property developer in Hong Kong, the Mainland, Singapore, the United Kingdom, continental Europe, Australia, and Canada. The company engages in the development and investment in residential, commercial, and industrial properties; operation of hotels, serviced suites, and pubs; and investment in infrastructure and utility asset operation. It also provides property and project management, finance, and property agency services. The company was formerly known as Cheung Kong Property Holdings Limited and changed its name to CK Asset Holdings Limited in September 2017. CK Asset Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Central, Hong Kong.

financial_summary: CK Asset Hldgs Ltd is a large-cap real estate business with a $21.5B market cap on $7.4B of annual revenue.

The top line has compounded at +1% over the past three years, which puts it in mature, slow-growth territory. Operating margins are contracting by -4.1pp, the first warning that competitive pressure is eroding the franchise.
Returns on capital run at 2% against a 7% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests. Gross margins of 53% confirm genuine pricing power.

The business throws off $2.1B in free cash flow — roughly 28 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 1.68× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, leverage is comfortably conservative at 1.2× net debt/EBITDA, and interest coverage runs at 5.5×.

Shareholder yield of 3.6% reflects a genuine commitment to returning capital rather than empire-building, and insider ownership is negligible, so management has little personal stake in the long-term outcome.
